## Wave 5 Summary

Wave 5 resolves whether the substrate's heat-trace dimension-spectrum signature carries a genuine complex-dimension line `Im(s) ≠ 0` (discrete-scale-invariance fine structure) once the oscillatory residual is rebuilt at HIGHER DYNAMIC RANGE. The S104 W3-2 gate (`S104-LOG-PERIODIC-IMS`) closed **INFO** — `cross_axis_stable=False`, `n_members_with_peak=6/6`, `max_prominence=3e+11`, `strongest_omega=6.47762 rad/lnt`, `implied_s=4+i0`, `omega_min=0.682188`, `R_osc_sibling=2.232e-05` (`computations/session-104/s104_gate_verdicts.txt`). That INFO was read as a smoothing/subtraction-order artifact because the S104 residual was the S61 on-disk `s61_hk_oscillation.npz` field set — only **200 log-spaced t-points over a 992-mode S61 spectrum**, a dynamic range at which the scheme-dependent sidelobes cannot be cleanly distinguished from a line.

This wave recomputes `K(t) = Tr e^{−t D_K²}` and the Strutinsky-split oscillatory residual `K_osc(t)` **directly from the s84 L=12 fold spectrum** (`s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz`: 90 Peter-Weyl `(p,q)` sectors, 166,896 block eigenvalues; ~32M eigenvalues with full PW multiplicity `dim_SU3(p,q)` vs the S61 992-mode residual), then runs the **IDENTICAL pinned S104 pipeline** — multiplicative `e^{4u}` detrend (poleconv-A, `Re(s)*=4`, `(pole_in_s=4, curvature_grade_n=0)`), Hann window, 2048-pt uniform-u grid, prominence floor `≥ 10× median broadband`, interior-local-maximum guard, Hann→rectangular window-invariance cross-check, and the `γ/d ∈ {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}` × SDW-order `∈ {2, 3, 4}` cross-axis stability conjunction — at the higher dynamic range. **Every pipeline parameter is IDENTICAL to the S104 pre-registration; the only declared deltas are the source spectrum and the native t-grid density.** This makes the re-run structurally distinct from iterate-until-PASS (PROHIBITED_ACTIONS Class 6) by construction: it is the SAME pre-registered criterion applied to a higher-dynamic-range input, NOT a re-tuning of the criterion to chase PASS.

Substrate-first prediction: the Jensen deformation of `SU(3)` is **not exactly self-similar**, so the fabric's dimension spectrum carries no discrete-scale-invariance line — the substrate-first expectation is **FAIL** (the CM-1995 simple-real dimension-spectrum wall re-confirmed at HDR; corridor-closing outcome). The carry-forward source is `session-104-w3-workingpaper.md §"Carry-Forward Computations"` (the conditional CF that fires only on INFO; INFO fired).

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The substrate-first prediction is NO complex-dimension line (Im(s) = 0),
            i.e. the expected verdict is FAIL (CM-1995 wall re-confirmed at HDR)."

    Step 1 — Definitions:
      D_K            = Dirac operator on Jensen-deformed SU(3) at τ_fold = 0.190 (canonical, tau_fold).
      K(t)           = Tr e^{−t D_K²} = Σ_{(p,q)} dim_SU3(p,q) · Σ_i exp(−t·|λ_i|²)   [heat trace; eq. P(σ)=Σ dim(p,q) Σ exp(−σ λ²)].
      K̃(t)           = Σ_{n∈{0,2,4,6,8}} a_n^{ζ} · t^{(n−d)/2}, d=8                  [Strutinsky/SDW smooth part, zeta-regulated].
      K_osc(t)       = K(t) − K̃(t)                                                   [oscillatory shell residual].
      g(u)           = K_osc(e^u)·e^{u·Re(s)*}, Re(s)* = 4                            [multiplicative log-detrend, poleconv-A n=0 grade].
      Sd             = pole set of ζ_{D_K}(s) = {0, 2, 4, 6, 8} at d=8 (CM-1995 dimension spectrum, SU(3)) [PROVEN; simple, REAL].
      Im(s)          = angular frequency ω* of any stationary cosine cos(ω*·ln t) in g(u) (Hoffer-Lapidus 2508.09512).

    Step 2 — Substitution (CM-1995 simple-real-dimension-spectrum wall into the residual form):
      A complex dimension s = Re(s)* + i·ω* with ω* ≠ 0 ⟺ g(u) carries a stationary cosine cos(ω*·u) ⟺ a discrete
      spectral LINE in the FFT of g(u) above ω_min. CM-1995 §5 (PROVEN, Connes-Moscovici regular spectral triple)
      establishes Sd ⊂ ℝ (simple, real) for (A_K, H_K, D_K) ⟹ NO s with Im(s) ≠ 0 in the dimension spectrum.

    Step 3 — Simplification (self-similarity ⟺ discrete-scale-invariance line):
      A discrete-scale-invariance (log-periodic) line at ω* requires the spectrum {|λ_i|} to be (asymptotically)
      self-similar under |λ| → |λ|·e^{2π/ω*} (geometric ladder). The Jensen TT-deformation of SU(3) at τ_fold = 0.190
      is NOT exactly self-similar (the deformation breaks the would-be geometric Weyl ladder); the |λ_i| are NOT a clean
      geometric progression ⟹ no asymptotic self-similarity ⟹ ω* (Im(s)) has no fixed line.
      = K_osc(t) is a SCHEME-DEPENDENT subtraction residual (its content depends on the SDW order and γ/d smoother),
        NOT a regulator-robust geometric oscillation.

    Step 4 — Direction read-off (from the canonical form):
      CM-1995 (Sd real) ∧ (Jensen deformation not self-similar) ⟹ NO STABLE ω* line across the regulator family
      ⟹ predicted verdict FAIL (no peak above the 10× floor that is stable across all 6 γ/d × SDW members).
      The HIGHER dynamic range (166,896 block / ~32M PW-weighted modes vs S61's 992) SHARPENS the residual but does
      NOT create self-similarity ⟹ the substrate-first direction is UNCHANGED: predicted no-line.

    Step 5 — [SIGN] verdict mapping (IDENTICAL to S104 convention):
      sign_verdict = PASS  ⟺ computed direction matches the substrate-first FAIL prediction (no stable line).
      sign_verdict = FAIL  ⟺ a stable line appears where the wall predicted none (Im(s) ≠ 0; PASS top-line verdict).
      sign_verdict = N/A   ⟺ unstable/scheme-dependent peak (INFO top-line verdict; direction ambiguous).

    Conclusion: substrate-first prediction = FAIL (CM-1995 wall re-confirmed at HDR); a PASS would FALSIFY the
                substrate-first expectation and FORCE a CM-1995 reconciliation (connes-ncg-theorist cross-check).

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: >
  EXISTS a stable interior complex-dimension line Im(s)=ω* > ω_min (= 0.6821881769209206) with prominence ≥ 10×
  median broadband on ALL 6 family members (γ/d ∈ {1.0,1.5,2.0} × SDW order ∈ {2,3,4}) AND ω* agrees within ±1 FFT
  bin across the full family, surviving the Hann→rectangular window-invariance cross-check. Solution-space meaning:
  the substrate's dimension spectrum carries genuine discrete-scale-invariance fine structure (Im(s) ≠ 0) at the
  HDR — IN TENSION with the PROVEN CM-1995 simple-real-Sd wall; a CM-1995 reconciliation gate (connes-ncg-theorist
  cross-check) is REQUIRED. This would FALSIFY the substrate-first prediction (the Jensen deformation would have to
  be asymptotically self-similar after all).
FAIL_meaning: >
  NO member clears the 10× prominence floor with an interior line at ANY γ/d OR SDW order at the HDR. Solution-space
  meaning: the CM-1995 simple-(real)-dimension-spectrum wall is RE-CONFIRMED on the frequency-domain axis at higher
  dynamic range — the corridor-closing outcome. The S104 INFO sidelobes were a low-dynamic-range artifact that the
  s84 L=12 rebuild dissolves. Im(s) = 0 detectable; the substrate-first prediction is CONFIRMED; the discrete-scale-
  invariance corridor is closed. (FAIL is the expected substrate-first result and is a clean elimination, NOT a
  shortfall.)
INFO_meaning: >
  A peak appears at one or more members but is NOT cross-axis stable (the ±1-bin agreement OR the all-6 floor fails)
  at the HDR. Solution-space meaning: the scheme-dependent sidelobe reading PERSISTS even at the s84 L=12 dynamic
  range — the dynamic-range upgrade did NOT resolve the S104 ambiguity. The residual carries SDW-order / γ/d-smoother
  structure that is not a regulator-robust complex dimension. (No further HDR escalation is pre-registered this
  session; the artifact reading stands. Maps to the schema-v2 collapse: sign=N/A, magnitude=INFO, regime=MARGINAL.)
